title: Hotline script
description: Script for staff who answer a guest or family hotline during an incident: the opening line, what may be said, what must not be said, questions to ask, and when to hand off. Facts in the script match the latest approved statement.

examples: Version 3, approved 17:40 by Guest Care and Legal
Thank you for calling Calloway Guest Care. I am sorry you are worried. I will tell you what we know and take your details.
Some guests and crew have had stomach illness; we reported it to the CDC.
Medical care is available on board at no charge to guests.

doNotSay.description: What the agent must not say
examples: Do not give the number of cases; refer to the latest statement.

ask.description: What the agent asks the caller
examples: The guest name and cabin, and the caller phone number
Whether the caller needs a message passed to the guest

handoff.description: When and to whom the agent hands off
examples: Hand off to the duty manager for any media caller, lawyer, or caller who says a guest has died.
